extraction.Name: Mary Whiting
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded November 8, 1918, by Edward L. Whiting
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to T. W. Woods for $9000 on February 21, 1920; conveyed to the Omaha Trust Company for $1.00 on January 16, 1923
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612835 issued; Southeast quarter section 8, township 99, north of range [number not stated]; receipt for the patent was signed February 1918 by the allottee; Mary and Edward Whiting conveyed land to the Omaha Trust Company
